structs.notes: The connection object is the ClConnection object of this struct (ms_connections holds pointers to it, 322584 apart). The reliable state is an embedded ClConnectionData at +16: every Replay reader in PushReliableCommand, DumpReliableCommands and ConnectedPacketEvent agrees with IDA ClConnectionData offsets, so the existing IDA members at 24, 32, 132140 are right and the rest of the old layout (1057152 bytes, command buffers A/B) is wrong. Game-test ClConnection (16 bytes, vftable + localClientNum + numPacketsReceived) is a base-class view, not this object. Deleting-dtor lead: none, ClConnectionMP::scalar_deleting_dtor@0x1415e02d0 calls bdMemory::deallocate_5 with no size argument, and FreeClientConnections has none, so the size rests on the allocation stride. Verdict resolved refers to the size and the members read in the 13 functions read (listed in results); the broader sweep is noted under unconfirmed.
